notes.title: v.1.1.1 - QoL update now available
notes.notes:
Greetings bot-bashers!

We've just released the 1.1.1 update, with general usability improvements and some minor bug fixes. Patch notes are as follows:

- Fix for CHIP holotable tips not showing after exiting the Mission Select screen
- Fix for buttons showing in intro/outro for remote players when clicking with mouse
- Fix for modal buttons potentially becoming deselected
- Fix for players deselecting their character after the game owner selects Ready To Start
- Fix for Aerovan menus being stuck open when a player disconnects
- Fix for error when a player disconnects from a game during the Aerovan zoom in
- Fix for Perfection and Turing Test achievements not firing for the remote player
- Fix for Character Select menu issues when the remote player presses a button to invite friends/go online
- Fix for Complete The Set achievement not firing when two or more players build turrets
- Fix for build menu arrows being incorrect size when opening the menu for the first time
- Fix for Character Select failing to display the server region after attempting to join a game with a different server region

- Amended the ground shader to be more performant and to assist consoles
- Amended cursor sprite size

- Added additional localisation strings and amended description of selling turrets to dismantling turrets
- Added additional tips to CHIP holotable and to the CHIP wiki
- Added new UI banner at level start and when EMP is 100% charged
- Added new UI showing tips when a mission is failed
- Added message in Join Game screen indicating players must be in the same server region to play together
- Added reminder of what a level's challenge is in the Pause menu
- Added additional background overlay when opening Options in the Pause menu

A reminder that Bish Bash Bots supports Steam's 'Remote Play Together', meaning that if one person owns the game they can invite Steam friends to their match through the Steam overlay as if you were all playing locally. Just hit Shift + Tab and head to the Friends tab, then right-click on the people you want to join your game and invite them with Remote Play. That's all there is to it!

As 2023 draws to a close, we want to thank you for your continued support and wish everybody a safe and healthy festive season. See you in 2024!

Lots of love,

CATASTROPHIC_OVERLOAD & Firestoke

notes.title: Demo Available Now & Release Date Reveal!
notes.notes:
Hi all, we're super excited to be releasing an official demo for Bish Bash Bots on Steam! If you wanna give the game a go before release, or you still need to convince all your friends to wishlist, this is your chance 😄

The demo includes online play as well so if you're not a solo gamer you can play with up to 4 total players 🎮🎮🎮🎮

Along with the demo, we are also dropping the upcoming release date: October 19th this year! 🥳 We've come such a long way and are happy to be entering this final stretch. A big thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way 😊

We hope you enjoy the demo and don't hesitate to let us know your thoughts, you can join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/DzCsxKyYBe]here![/url]
